title: The Burrows-Wheeler Transform
text:
The Burrows-Wheeler Transform (BWT) is a remarkable algorithm that rearranges a string into a form that compresses much more efficiently. It is the backbone of bzip2 and powers DNA sequence alignment tools like Bowtie and BWA.
In this article, we build it from scratch — interactively.
